fusions.name: Studied Swell
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second cast, sends a swell of water that deals 34 damage, always as a critical hit, and leaves the target [Stalled] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Ripples
fusions.desc: A drilled flick of the tail deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Second Nature
fusions.desc: Increases the healing you receive by 30% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Strokes
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
